name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited
summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction company in India and internationally. The company operates through Construction Contract, Lease Rental, and Others segments. Its portfolio includes residential and commercial buildings/complexes, hotels, institutional and hospital buildings, corporate offices, information technology (IT) parks, industrial complexes, automated car parking lot, townships, BOT projects, metro station and depot, redevelopment/upgradation of railway stations, urban infrastructure, and data centres.
